_doc: The roll from the keys a player presses, filmed from the right on the flat ground east of the Cracked Toll: a jog on W, then Ctrl (the Dodge key), then a tap of Shift (Sprint tapped rolls). Real key events through the input map, eight frames 0.08 s apart from the moment of the key. Forward+ as the player sees it: xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1600x900x24' godot --path game --rendering-driver vulkan --rendering-method forward_plus --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1600x900 --fixed-fps 60 -- --capture=tools/capture/plans/roll.json --out=captures/roll
